string.name: watch_name
string.description: Spoken and shown name of the tool

string.name: watch_launcher_label
string.description: Launcher name, so the user can say Open Watch For Text

string.name: watch_button
string.description: Button on the camera screen that opens the tool

string.name: watch_button_description
string.description: Accessibility description of that button

resources.string: Open watch for text. Tells you when it sees a word or number you ask for.

string.name: watch_help
string.description: Spoken list of what can be said in this tool

resources.string: I keep reading what your glasses see and tell you when your word or number appears, and which side it\'s on. You can say: watch for, then a word or number. Where is it. What are you watching for. Watch for something else. Stop watching. Carry on watching. Ticks off, ticks on, or tick every 20 seconds. Or close. Keep using your cane or dog as usual.

string.name: watch_ask_target
string.description: Asked when opened with nothing to watch for

resources.string: What should I watch for? Say a word or a number, like 42, or exit.

string.name: watch_start_first
string.description: First time watching starts; %1$s is the target

resources.string: I\'ll tell you when I see %1$s. Keep using your cane or dog as usual.

string.name: watch_start
string.description: Watching starts again or with a new target; %1$s is the target

string.name: watch_resumed
string.description: Watching restarted; %1$s is the target

string.name: watch_didnt_get_target
string.description: The target couldn't be understood

resources.string: Sorry, I didn\'t get what to watch for. Say a word or a number.

string.name: watch_seen
string.description: Target seen; %1$s is the target, %2$s where (e.g. on your right)

string.name: watch_left
string.description: Position of the text

string.name: watch_right
string.description: Position of the text

string.name: watch_ahead
string.description: Position of the text

string.name: watch_where_close
string.description: Position plus nearness; %1$s is the position

string.name: watch_where_far
string.description: Position plus nearness; %1$s is the position

string.name: watch_gone
string.description: The target has been out of view for a few seconds; %1$s is the target

string.name: watch_near_miss
string.description: Something nearly matched; %1$s what was seen, %2$s the target

string.name: watch_where_in_view
string.description: Where is it, while in view; %1$s target, %2$s position

string.name: watch_where_last_seen
string.description: Where is it, after it went; %1$s target, %2$s position, %3$d seconds ago

string.name: watch_where_not_seen
string.description: Where is it, before any sighting; %1$s target

resources.string: I haven\'t seen %1$s yet. I\'m still watching.

string.name: watch_where_nothing
string.description: Where is it, with no target

resources.string: I\'m not watching for anything. Say watch for, then a word or number.

string.name: watch_what_target
string.description: What are you watching for; %1$s target

string.name: watch_what_target_stopped
string.description: What are you watching for, while stopped; %1$s target

resources.string: I was watching for %1$s, but I\'ve stopped. Say carry on watching to start again.

string.name: watch_stopped
string.description: Stop watching; %1$s target

resources.string: Stopped watching for %1$s. Say carry on watching, or watch for something else.

string.name: watch_paused
string.description: Pause; %1$s target

resources.string: Paused. Say carry on to keep watching for %1$s.

string.name: watch_not_watching
string.description: Stop or where with nothing being watched

resources.string: I\'m not watching for anything. Say watch for, then a word or number.

string.name: watch_ticks_off
string.description: Alive tick turned off

resources.string: Ticks off. I\'ll still tell you if something goes wrong.

string.name: watch_ticks_every
string.description: Alive tick interval; %1$d seconds

resources.string: I\'ll tick every %1$d seconds while I watch.

string.name: watch_covered
string.description: Image check: lens covered

resources.string: I can\'t see anything. Is something covering the camera? It\'s at the front left of your glasses.

string.name: watch_dark
string.description: Image check: too dark

resources.string: It\'s too dark for me to read signs here.

string.name: watch_view_back
string.description: The view problem cleared; %1$s target

resources.string: I can see again. Still watching for %1$s.

string.name: watch_slow
string.description: OCR can't keep up; %1$d seconds between looks

resources.string: Reading is slow on this phone. I can only look about every %1$d seconds.

string.name: watch_no_frames
string.description: Streaming but no pictures arrive

resources.string: I\'m not getting pictures from your glasses camera. I\'ll keep trying.

string.name: watch_ocr_failed
string.description: Text recognition keeps failing

resources.string: Text recognition isn\'t working right now. I\'ll keep trying.

string.name: watch_reminder_ask
string.description: Silence reminder while asking for a target

resources.string: Still here. What should I watch for? Say a word or a number, or say close.

string.name: watch_reminder_stopped
string.description: Silence reminder while stopped; %1$s target

resources.string: I\'m not watching right now. Say carry on watching for %1$s, watch for something else, or close.

string.name: watch_screen_target
string.description: Screen: what is being watched for; %1$s target

string.name: watch_screen_stopped
string.description: Screen: stopped; %1$s target

string.name: watch_screen_no_target
string.description: Screen: no target yet

resources.string: Not watching yet. Say what to watch for.

string.name: watch_screen_last
string.description: Screen: last sighting; %1$s

string.name: watch_screen_pace
string.description: Screen: OCR time per frame and frames per second; %1$d ms, %2$s fps

resources.string: Reading takes %1$d ms a look, %2$s looks a second

string.name: watch_screen_read
string.description: Screen: what OCR read in the last frame; %1$s

string.name: watch_screen_read_nothing
string.description: Screen: OCR read nothing

string.name: watch_button_where
string.description: Button: say where the target is

string.name: watch_button_stop
string.description: Button: stop watching

string.name: watch_button_resume
string.description: Button: start watching again

string.name: watch_button_change
string.description: Button: watch for something else (asks by voice)

string.name: watch_button_ticks
string.description: Button: change the alive tick; %1$s current setting

string.name: watch_ticks_off_short
string.description: Tick setting shown on the button

string.name: watch_ticks_every_short
string.description: Tick setting shown on the button; %1$d seconds
